parameters.content:
## Reasignación: Checkin condicional → Checkout → Retry

Snipe-IT rechaza el checkout si el activo ya está asignado (`current_user_id`).
`Not Needs Checkin?` rutea: vacío → `Checkout Asset` directo al nuevo
titular; ocupado → `Checkin Asset` directo + `Retry Checkout`.

1. **Checkout Asset** — intento optimista. Lo que falla sale por la rama
   de error (`onError: continueErrorOutput`), no tumba el flujo.
2. **Checkin Asset** — libera el activo
   (`POST /checkin`, nota "Reasignacion a titular activo").
   `onError: continueRegularOutput`: aunque falle
   (ej. no estaba asignado), igual sigue al reintento.
3. **Retry Checkout** — mismo checkout con el activo libre.
   Éxito → `Checkout OK`; fallo → `Checkout Failed`
   (auditado en `integration_sync_log`).

## ③ Precarga bulk + aplicar en Snipe-IT y auditar
Precarga hasta 3000 usuarios (GETs paginados de 500 → mapa bulk) y crea faltantes (1 por email distinto, con reintento por username y recuperación por email). `snipe_user_id` viene del mapa (salvo duplicados: 1 GET/email). Asigna (`checkout` con `checkin` + reintento). Registra éxito/error y resumen.

## ② Detectar cambios (staging + diff)
Carga el `titular deseado` en `staging_titular` y compara contra `snipe_titular_map`/`user_map`. Solo activos ya mapeados en `tryton_snipe_asset_map` siguen (el resto → `omitidos`). Solo los cambios siguen.

## ① Obtener datos del ERP
Titular autoritativo desde Tryton: `login@guayas.gob.ec`. Lee activos con titular, extrae owner_ids y consulta empleados activos.

SELECT jsonb_agg(json_build_object('email', t.email, 'first_name', t.first_name, 'last_name', t.last_name, 'username', split_part(t.email,'@',1))) AS payload
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (LOWER(s.email)) LOWER(s.email) AS email, s.first_name, s.last_name
  FROM staging_titular s
  WHERE s.email IS NOT NULL AND s.email <> ''
    AND LOWER(s.email) NOT IN (SELECT email FROM snipe_titular_user_map WHERE email IS NOT NULL)
  ORDER BY LOWER(s.email)
) t;

INSERT INTO snipe_titular_user_map(email, snipe_user_id, updated_at)
SELECT DISTINCT ON (LOWER(x.email)) LOWER(x.email), x.id, now()
FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) AS x(email text, id int)
WHERE x.email IS NOT NULL AND x.email <> ''
ORDER BY LOWER(x.email), x.id
ON CONFLICT (email) DO UPDATE SET snipe_user_id = EXCLUDED.snipe_user_id, updated_at = now();

parameters.content:
## Tryton sync titular↔activo (v1)
Mantiene al día el TITULAR de cada activo en Snipe-IT (requisito del flujo 2.3).

**Fuente autoritativa**: empleados ACTIVOS con contrato vigente del ERP (res_user.login → correo institucional login@guayas.gob.ec, que coincide con AD/Zammad).

**Patrón batch/diff**: staging + diff contra los mapas (snipe_titular_map/_user_map) → solo aplica los CAMBIOS (nuevo titular o titular distinto). Idempotente.

Lo invoca el orquestador de assets al final; también corre manual.

**Extraer activos y titulares** (Code):
filtra `current_owner != null`, construye `assets:[{code, owner_id}]` (→ Estado deseado) y deduplica `owner_ids` via `Set` (→ Empleados ERP `= ANY($1)`). Se mantiene como Code (1 pasada) vs Set 3.4 que duplicaría filter/map y es ilegible.

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO integration_sync_log (execution_id, workflow_name, source_system, entity, entity_id, entity_tag, operation, response_status, response_body, error_message, retry_count)
VALUES ($1,$2,'tryton','titular',0,$3,'run_summary',0,$4,$5,0);

INSERT INTO integration_sync_log (execution_id, workflow_name, source_system, entity, entity_id, entity_tag, operation, tryton_id, snipe_id, response_status, response_body, error_message, retry_count)
SELECT $1, $2, 'tryton', 'titular', 0, x.snipe_asset_tag, 'titular_checkout', 0, COALESCE(x.snipe_asset_id,0), COALESCE(x.response_status,0), COALESCE(x.response_body,''), COALESCE(x.error_message,''), 0
FROM jsonb_to_recordset($3::jsonb) AS x(snipe_asset_tag text, email text, first_name text, last_name text, snipe_asset_id int, snipe_user_id int, created_user boolean, status text, error_message text, response_status int, response_body text)
WHERE x.status = 'error';

SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS omitidos
FROM staging_titular s
LEFT JOIN tryton_snipe_asset_map am
  ON am.snipe_asset_tag = s.snipe_asset_tag AND am.snipe_asset_id IS NOT NULL
WHERE am.snipe_asset_tag IS NULL;

INSERT INTO snipe_titular_map(snipe_asset_tag, email, snipe_user_id, updated_at)
SELECT DISTINCT ON (x.snipe_asset_tag) x.snipe_asset_tag, x.email, x.snipe_user_id, now()
FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) AS x(snipe_asset_tag text, email text, first_name text, last_name text, snipe_asset_id int, snipe_user_id int, created_user boolean, status text, error_message text, response_status int, response_body text)
WHERE x.status = 'ok'
ORDER BY x.snipe_asset_tag
ON CONFLICT (snipe_asset_tag) DO UPDATE SET email = EXCLUDED.email, snipe_user_id = EXCLUDED.snipe_user_id, updated_at = now();

INSERT INTO snipe_titular_user_map(email, snipe_user_id, updated_at)
SELECT DISTINCT ON (x.email) x.email, x.snipe_user_id, now()
FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) AS x(snipe_asset_tag text, email text, first_name text, last_name text, snipe_asset_id int, snipe_user_id int, created_user boolean, status text, error_message text, response_status int, response_body text)
WHERE x.status = 'ok' AND x.email IS NOT NULL AND x.email <> ''
ORDER BY x.email
ON CONFLICT (email) DO UPDATE SET snipe_user_id = EXCLUDED.snipe_user_id, updated_at = now();

SELECT s.snipe_asset_tag, s.email, s.first_name, s.last_name,
       am.snipe_asset_id,
       um.snipe_user_id AS existing_user_id,
       tm.snipe_user_id AS current_user_id
FROM staging_titular s
JOIN tryton_snipe_asset_map am
  ON am.snipe_asset_tag = s.snipe_asset_tag AND am.snipe_asset_id IS NOT NULL
LEFT JOIN snipe_titular_map tm      ON tm.snipe_asset_tag = s.snipe_asset_tag
LEFT JOIN snipe_titular_user_map um ON um.email = LOWER(s.email)
WHERE s.email IS NOT NULL AND s.email <> ''
  AND (tm.snipe_asset_tag IS NULL
    OR tm.email IS DISTINCT FROM s.email);

SELECT DISTINCT ON (pp.id)
       pp.id AS party_id,
       ru.login,
       pp.last_name  AS apellidos,
       pp.first_name AS nombres
FROM financiero.company_employee ce
JOIN financiero.party_party pp      ON pp.id = ce.party
JOIN financiero.company_contract cc ON cc.employee = ce.id
JOIN financiero.res_user ru         ON ce.id = ru.employee
WHERE pp.last_name IS NOT NULL AND pp.first_name IS NOT NULL
  AND cc.state IN ('done')
  AND ru.active = true
  AND ru.login LIKE '%.%'
  AND pp.id = ANY($1)
ORDER BY pp.id, cc.contract_date DESC NULLS LAST;
